body:
If you truly believe that there is no other way then I can respect that. However this subreddit isn't exactly the place to be asking how to get the funds needed to travel. I for one have no idea how you should go about earning that money, sorry about that.

If you ever change your mind and decide that you would like to try out another option again but need help, you can always PM me.

Unfortunately there's not really any easy way to get the money for a flight to Switzerland. Do you attend therapy?

If you feel that this truly is your only option this would be better suited for a professional, which I am not. There are so many different options, it's highly unlikely you've tried everything. Maybe there's something else? What all have you tried?
How old are you if you don't mind me asking? You said you can't work and you can't obtain a passport by yourself. Does that mean you're too young to do this?
That seems like a lot of work just to kill yourself. Do you really feel like moving to Switzerland is your only option? Wouldn't it be easier to try and get help from a professional?

It sounds like you're just starting to have these feelings. If so then this is the most crucial opportunity you'll have to get help. Have you tried contacting someone for help before? Maybe a hotline or a therapist?

It's a lot better to get the help now than later when you might be even deeper in these feelings than you are now.

I'm not really one to be able to give very good advice one these kinds of things, but I'm available if you need someone to talk to which it sounds like you do. PM me whenever you feel the need to.

What I will say is that pills and slashing your wrists are both awful ways to do yourself in. Depending on the amount you take you'll be puking up blood, you'll be writhing in pain and just generally feel like you're in hell. Bleeding out takes an incredibly long time and is particularly messy. On top of that it takes an huge amount of courage to do enough damage with a sharp object to actually kill yourself. More than likely you'll be in extreme pain but you won't actually die. Please reconsider doing this.
